_comment: Full title-screen loop: boot at title, New Game, walk to the inn door (autosave beat, now floodplains-bound per the door retarget), Quit to Title with confirm, Continue, verify restored state. starts_at_title bypasses the harness title-skip so this script drives the gate/menu directly. Issue #43 re-pin: headless QA runs a DEBUG binary, so the new debug-only 'Playtest States' row IS visible here -- both ui_title_rendered waits now pin selectable_rows (the device-of-truth row count, read live off OS.is_debug_build()/Continue's own enabled state, not hardcoded) to prove the gate is live: 4 selectable rows before any save exists (New Game/Playtest States/Quit/Settings -- Continue skipped), 5 once the autosave lands (Continue newly selectable). Issue #77 re-pin: 'Settings' APPENDED at the end of ROWS bumped both counts by 1 (was 3/4) -- it's always selectable, so it rides along in every ui_title_rendered snapshot; appending (never inserting earlier) left every other row's INDEX and this script's own navigation (move down 1 to reach Continue, move down 6 to reach 'Quit to Title' inside the pause menu below) byte-unchanged.

steps._comment: New Game opens on the GDI black cold-open (4 arrival lines). QA-collapsed to an instant coverage event fired right after world_ready. Never fires on the Continue path below (GAME_LOADED, not GAME_RESET).

Issue #88 (gap-2) QA teeth: New Game a SECOND time, now that 'auto' holds a finished (well, classless-but-real) run -- pins the overwrite-confirm panel's coverage event AND that TestDriver's collapse (title_screen.gd's `_is_qa()`, the sleep_veil.gd precedent) never hangs: no step here drives the interactive Confirm/Cancel choice, exactly like every other veil mode's own QA contract (a human windowed playtest exercises that; see title_screen.gd's `_enter_new_game_confirm` doc comment).
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: Cursor already sits on row 0 ('New Game', always selectable, see `_enter_menu`'s own `_row_selectable(0)` precedence) -- a bare Confirm reproduces the exact same keypress every pre-#88 canonical's FIRST New Game already used, only THIS time an existing save makes the new gate live.
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: The prompt's own pin: `_format_slot_summary` on the 'auto' slot's metadata -- classless (no sleep occurred anywhere in this run) so top_class stays empty, pc_name defaults 'Traveler', map is wherever 'auto' was last written ('floodplains', the door-crossing autosave earlier in this script).

THE bypass teeth: game_reset follows immediately, with no interactive wait in between (the collapse auto-resolves to 'Yes' the same beat _enter_new_game_confirm emits the coverage event above) -- if TestDriver ever stopped bypassing this panel, this wait would time out.

The auto_prev rotation teeth: game.gd's `_rotate_auto_pending` (armed by THIS New Game's reset()) fires on the FIRST save_auto below -- the door-crossing autosave, same trigger the first New Game used to seed 'auto' originally -- copying the OLD 'auto' (the just-quit run's own Traveler/Floodplains state) to 'auto_prev' BEFORE this fresh run's own state overwrites 'auto'.
